messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary group for /v3/prompt-route (deploy-2026-03-17-09) showing elevated errors and latency. 5xx=12% over last 2m, p95=3.2s > 1.2s SLO. Flag exp-new-routing=true, canary at 15%.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC12345 created and paged raj. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/canary-failure
raj (oncall): I'm on it. Paging SRE for immediate FF kill and rollback.
miles (sre): Oncall SRE here, standing by. Can you confirm which flag to flip?
raj (oncall): exp-new-routing — need emergency toggle OFF. Do NOT restart the canary until rollback finishes.
miles (sre): Running toggle now.
miles (sre): ```bash
# feature flag toggle via internal API
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN' 
  https://flags.redwood.internal/toggle 
  -d '{"flag":"exp-new-routing","enabled":false,"actor":"sre/miles"}'
```
miles (sre): Response: {"flag":"exp-new-routing","enabled":false,"changed_by":"sre/miles","ts":"2026-03-17T09:07:12Z"} :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for deploy-2026-03-17-09. Canary traffic draining, switching to stable model variant.
jenny (prod-eng): Logs from canary containers show repeated upstream 502s from prompt-gateway: 
```
2026-03-17T09:05:04Z ERROR prompt-gateway request_id=abc123 upstream_error=502 connect_timeout
2026-03-17T09:05:05Z ERROR prompt-gateway request_id=def456 kvcache-miss -> spiking latency
```
lina (cust-success): CS note: two enterprise customers reported errors in the last 6m. I'm opening tickets and sending an initial incident update. Will provide customer list in 10m.
raj (oncall): Good — prioritize contacting the ones with SLAs. SRE, confirm when 5xx falls under 1%.
miles (sre): Metrics dropping as traffic moves off canary. p95 now 520ms, 5xx=1.8% and falling.
sophia (next-oncall): Taking handoff at 09:16. I'll watch for secondary failures and coordinate postmortem. Adding myself to the incident.
raj (oncall): Handoff to sophia for investigation and RCA. I'll remain notified until incident is closed.
miles (sre): Canary instances terminated, rollback complete. Current stats: p95=440ms, 5xx=0.7%. No ongoing elevated errors.
jenny (prod-eng): Confirmed rollback removed the new routing kernel that surfaced incompatibility with our batching layer. Will push a patch and retest in staging.
lina (cust-success): Sent 09:20 customer update: root cause unknown, rollback in progress, no action required from customers. Will follow up with RCA.
incident-bot: Incident INC12345 status: RESOLVED by raj -> handed to sophia for follow-up. Timeline: started 1764444444, resolved 1764444620. Postmortem requested within 48 hours.
sophia (next-oncall): Acknowledged. Creating incident thread in #postmortems and assigning owners. Thanks all — real-time fix worked, will do full RCA later. :eyes:
